**Four non-negotiables** — AD (V11 perf), Lipschitz refinement types (V11 crash), effect system (GPU/audio constraints), staged computation (scene→evaluator). These are the reason the language exists.

**All 10 research domains** mapped to specific engine bugs, prioritized must/should/could.

**Spec methodology** — problem→state of art→design→implementation→validation→fallback. Every spec earns its architecture through investigation.

**What Claude Code does** — research phase. Read specs, do deep research, write implementation-ready specs in CSL. Not compiler code yet. When the 11 specs are done, *then* implementation begins.
